head: 8c8e7d7a76c7711f8bd120bdadc913a1e73fdc11
claim: The built public BYOKit OpenClaw SDK boots OpenClaw2026.9.33, reads complete agent-scoped native Workshop instructions and refuses another agent and unsupported Telnyx installation, then one public native MiniMax-M3.1-Flash chat returns a fresh assistant marker. Billing remains API-key billed per use. This is not a physical HTTP request-count claim or a live addKey activation claim.

steps.start: Fresh isolated BYOKit app home; no imported login or environment key.
steps: Read native agent Workshop instructions and refuse another agent/third-party install
Store the app-passed key through the public native setter without a probe
Select the authenticated booted catalog Flash id
Send exactly one native chat and read its fresh assistant reply
steps.result: Real MiniMax reply returned stable-cc17e478-9177-4026-aab6-9e4689bbffda; this proves public native pass-through, not addKey activation.

verdicts.seen: Read all capture entries: gateway shows engine 2026.9.33 and phase ready; native Workshop shows completeContent true, otherAgentRefused true, thirdPartyInstall unsupported_plugin; credential stored as minimax:manual with verified false and no probe call; the catalog includes MiniMax-M3.1-Flash and catalog choice selects it; the chat turn returns status ok with text stable-cc17e478-9177-4026-aab6-9e4689bbffda matching the runId. Billing is stated as API-key billed per use. These fields match the outcome, which also disclaims physical request counts and live addKey activation, and the capture does not claim either.
